summary: Retest of the bank reconciliation fixes. test_iteration27_banca.py was extended to 35 tests: unit tests updated to the (score, name_hit) tuple, plus new tests for number boundaries and prefixes, safe_auto requiring a name match, GET config/riepilogo with own credentials, PUT clearing last_sync_error, empty email removing own credentials and falling back to SDI, split delete of the first or second payment, ref_ids listing only paid invoices, and passive payment delete resetting the movement. Result: 35/35 PASS. Regression: scadenzario/estratto/passive (iter 9/10/11) 53/55; the 2 failures need a local debug SMTP and are not caused by these fixes. Banche/moduli (iter 20/22) 42/42. UI (Playwright on the main agent's TEST_Banca Srl): after saving Open Banking credentials, banca-status shows 'A-Cube Open Banking · ambiente di prova', psd2-connect-btn and psd2-sync-btn are enabled, and this persists after reload. The password placeholder says a password is saved. Fast filter-chip switching with an artificial 2.5 s delay on da_riconciliare requests always shows rows that match the active chip (stale guard works). MatchDialog match-cancel-btn and match-tab-cat-0..6 work. All 5 previously reported issues are fixed.

minor.issue: A company saved before the fix (banca.password_enc set, no has_password) still shows 'non configurato' until an admin saves again. Confirmed on TEST_Banca Srl before the UI save. Suggest a one-time startup migration: updateMany({'banca.password_enc':{$exists:true}}, {$set:{'banca.has_password':true}}).

The prefix regex (fatt|ft|n|nr...) only checks the base number, not the year. So 'FATTURA 1/2025' still gives +35 to invoice 1/2026. Name tokens are words of 3+ characters, so generic words in a counterparty name (e.g. 'test', 'italia', 'service', 'group') count as a name hit. Low risk, because auto also needs a matching amount and no second candidate scoring >= 50.

ui_bugs.issue: After Sincronizza fails, the error toast appears but banca-status is not refreshed. run() -> reload() does not call loadCfg, so last_sync_error and last_sync_at only show after a page reload. Fix: call loadCfg() inside reload().

issues: Still crowded: the 5 buttons wrap onto 2 rows and the title wraps onto 2 lines (unchanged from iteration 27).

critical_code_review_comments: _unlink_payment deletes the sibling payments, sets the movement to da_riconciliare and filters by company_id. Verified for both incasso and pagamento.
put_banca_cfg replaces the whole banca sub-document. With an empty email, password_enc is removed (verified in the DB) and has_password=false.
_reconcile now builds ref_ids from righe. Verified: a 1220 movement split over [E,B] gives ref_ids [E], 1 payment, non_abbinato 0.

success_rate.backend: 100% (35/35 bank suite; regression 95/97, the 2 SMTP failures depend on the environment)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest test_iteration27_banca.py -n 0 (35 tests, about 90 s). Do not use the word 'TEST' in movement descriptions: the test customer is 'TEST_T27 Verdi...', so the token 'test' counts as a name hit. test_iteration11 fails when any company has P.IVA 01234567890 (TEST_Banca Srl had it; it is now deleted).
